_about: Shared test cases for the two rubric validators (CONTRACT-0024 section 3.4).
SQL: supabase/tests/pglite/run.mjs step0024 runs every case through public.bb_rubric_dan_problems / public.bb_rubric_is_valid.
JS: src/lib/blackBelt/checks.mjs runs every case through danProblems (rubric.js). Both must give exactly "expect".
A case with "dan_no" 1-4: start from Dan <dan_no> of the default rubric ("base": "default:<n>"), apply "ops" in order to that Dan object,
then the sorted, de-duplicated list of problem codes must equal "expect" ([] = valid).
A case with "dan_no": null and "base": "default": the ops apply to the WHOLE default rubric document; "expect_valid" is what bb_rubric_is_valid must answer.
ops: {"op": "set", "path": [...], "value": ...} sets (or adds) the value at the path (keys are strings, list positions are numbers; like jsonb_set);
Problem codes for fields without their own code (yes/no fields, the stamps, scoring, points_mode, missing or unknown keys) are "shape".
